Container.Name: paperless-printer
Container.Overview:
Print to PDF from any device. Paperless Printer is a network printer that saves every job as a PDF. Phones, tablets and computers on your LAN find it through AirPrint/Bonjour, print to it, and the PDF appears in a folder, for example the consume folder of paperless-ngx. PDFs appear only once complete, with the owner and permissions you choose, and are named after the document title.
Networking: keep Network Type on a custom network (br0, or eth0 when bridging is disabled) and set a Fixed IP address outside your router's DHCP range, so discovery works. On the Bridge or Host network, discovery does not work (Unraid runs its own mDNS service); add the printer manually as ipp://SERVER-IP:631/printers/Paperless_Printer instead.
Set an admin password, then print to "Paperless Printer". The CUPS admin pages are at https://CONTAINER-IP:631/admin (self-signed certificate).
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: print to pdf virtual printer pdf printer cups airprint ipp paperless-ngx scan
Container.Requires: A custom network (br0 or eth0) with a fixed IP for AirPrint/Bonjour discovery.

Config.Name: IPP and web UI port
Config.Description: IPP printing and the CUPS web UI (HTTPS for admin pages). Only used on the Bridge network; on br0 the printer listens on 631 at its own IP.

Config.Name: Output folder
Config.Description: Where finished PDFs are saved. Point it at paperless-ngx's consume folder to import every print.

Config.Name: Spool
Config.Description: Queued jobs, job numbers, the printer's UUID and its TLS certificate, kept across restarts and updates.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for the CUPS admin pages (single line). If empty, a random password is printed to the log at each start.

Config.Name: Printer name
Config.Description: Name shown to clients (at most 63 bytes, no #).

Config.Name: Printer location
Config.Description: Location shown to clients, e.g. Office.

Config.Name: Paper size
Config.Description: Default paper size.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the PDFs (99 = nobody, the Unraid default). Match the consumer, e.g. paperless-ngx's USERMAP_UID.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the PDFs (100 = users, the Unraid default). Match the consumer, e.g. paperless-ngx's USERMAP_GID.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permission mask for PDFs: 0000 gives 0666 (Unraid's share default), 0002 gives 0664, 0022 gives 0644.

Config.Name: Allowed clients
Config.Description: Space-separated CUPS addresses allowed to connect. @LOCAL means the container's own subnets, which on br0 is your LAN. On the Bridge network use all, or list your LAN subnet (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24).

Config.Name: File naming
Config.Description: 2 = Title-job_7.pdf, 1 = job_7-Title.pdf, 0 = Title.pdf. Existing files are never overwritten.

Config.Name: Queue name
Config.Description: CUPS queue name (letters, digits, _ and -), used in ipp://IP:631/printers/QUEUE.

Config.Name: Admin user
Config.Description: Admin user for the CUPS web UI. Must not be an existing system account or group.

Config.Name: Advertised host
Config.Description: Host or IP for the admin link in the Bonjour record, e.g. the fixed IP above.

Config.Name: Server aliases
Config.Description: Host names clients may use. Keep * unless you list every name and IP the printer is reached by.

Config.Name: Web interface
Config.Description: Set no to disable the CUPS web UI.

Config.Name: Bonjour/AirPrint
Config.Description: Set no to disable discovery (e.g. on the Bridge network).

Config.Name: Bonjour over IPv6
Config.Description: no advertises the printer over IPv4 only. Keep no if br0 has IPv6: an IPv6 address Docker gives the container can clash with the router's, and the printer is then renamed forever (Host name conflict in the log).

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: CUPS log level.
